meta.name: social
meta.description: When the user wants help creating, scheduling, or optimizing social media content for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or other platforms, or wants to do social listening and engagement triage. Also use when the user mentions 'LinkedIn post,' 'Twitter thread,' 'social media,' 'content calendar,' 'social scheduling,' 'engagement,' 'viral content,' 'what should I post,' 'repurpose this content,' 'tweet ideas,' 'LinkedIn carousel,' 'social media strategy,' 'grow my following,' 'TikTok video,' 'Reels,' 'Shorts,' 'video script,' 'video hook,' 'short-form video,' 'create a reel,' 'social listening,' 'brand mentions,' 'competitor monitoring,' 'top posts to comment on,' 'find people asking for,' 'carousel,' 'slide-by-slide,' or 'document post.' Use this for social media content creation, repurposing, scheduling, short-form video scripting, and social listening. For broader content strategy, see content-strategy. For paid ads, see ad-creative. For earned media, see public-relations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并排程全平台社媒内容，跟踪互动与品牌提及
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你负责品牌社媒账号，需要持续产出和排期内容。
copy.tagline_en: Create and schedule social media content across platforms, track engagement and mentions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage brand social accounts and need ongoing content production and scheduling.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按「社交媒体策略师」的角色工作:先读取产品营销背景并追问目标、受众、品牌语气、资源,再产出帖子文案、钩子、内容支柱、排期表、短视频脚本、社媒监听与互动分类结果。
howto.when: 当你说出「LinkedIn 帖子」「Twitter 线程」「社媒」等关键词,或要求创作、排期、优化社媒内容、短视频脚本、社交监听时触发。

say.text: 把这篇博客改写成一条 LinkedIn 帖子和一个 Twitter 线程。
say.note: Claude 会提取要点并按平台格式改写。

say.text: 给我 5 个短视频钩子,用于 TikTok 和 Reels。
say.note: 会按 3 秒规则生成钩子组合。

say.text: 安排一周的社媒内容日历,并列出可评论的帖子。
say.note: 会产出排期表并筛选互动目标。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude acts as a social media strategist: reads product-marketing context, asks about goals/audience/brand voice/resources, then drafts posts, hooks, content pillars, calendars, short-form video scripts, and engagement/listening triage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'LinkedIn post,' 'Twitter thread,' 'social media,' etc., or asks to create, schedule, or optimize social content, short-form video scripts, or do social listening.

say_en.text: Repurpose this blog post into a LinkedIn post and a Twitter thread.
say_en.note: Extracts key points and adapts per platform.

say_en.text: Give me 5 short-form video hooks for TikTok and Reels.
Plan a week of social content and list posts to comment on.
say_en.note: Produces a calendar and engagement targets.
